lines.text: Many learners say: I am interested with music.
Better: I am interested in music.
In! He is interested in sports.

native.tip: نقول بالعربية «مهتم بالموسيقى» بحرف الباء، لكن مع interested نستخدم in: “I am interested in music.” وليس “I am interested with music.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I am interested with music.” 😅 نقول بالعربية «مهتم بالموسيقى» بحرف الباء، لكن مع interested نستخدم in، فالجملة الصحيحة “I am interested in music.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.tip: In Arabic we say «مهتم بالموسيقى» with the letter «بـ», but after interested we use in: “I am interested in music.” not “I am interested with music.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I am interested with music.” 😅 In Arabic we say «مهتم بالموسيقى» with the letter «بـ», but after interested we use in, so the right sentence is “I am interested in music.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
